name: token-cost-breakdown
title: TokenCostBreakdown
description: A dl breakdown of a request/span/trace token usage and USD cost: input, output, cache tokens, total, and cost. Controlled and pure. Honest zeros (M9 SessionSummary convention): a real 0 renders 0 / $0.0000; an absent field renders an em-dash; all-absent renders an honest empty state.
